verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation of the transfer-in flow. Nothing covers the EPP/auth-code steps, transfer status tracking, transfer pricing, or what happens to remaining registration time. The Go SDK command list covers register, renew and registrar lock but no transfer-in operation. Two community comments do mention entering EPP codes and transfer promo pricing, but they are anecdotes, not evidence that the process is documented.

support.subject: As a power user, transferring domains IN is documented and honest — EPP/auth-code flow, status tracking, what the transfer costs, and what happens to remaining registration time
